description: Where AI pays off first in a company. 15 multiple-choice questions: role, size, industry, revenue, biggest cost block, where the time goes, AI use today, data, ownership, know-how, repetitive share, headcount, standardisation, mandate, timing. Returns maturity, impact and momentum scores (0 to 100) with readings, three ranked AI levers, a conservative effect range for the cost block and a short assessment. Deterministic and free; no sign-in, the e-mail is optional.

cost_block.description: Where is your biggest cost block? engineering = Engineering and development; sales_marketing = Sales and marketing; service = Service and after-sales; operations = Production, purchasing and supply chain; finance_admin = Finance and administration; it_data = IT and data

data.description: Where does the data for that block live? silos = In e-mails and Excel; mixed = Partly in ERP, CRM or PLM; central = Mostly in one system; apis = Structured and accessible via interfaces

email.description: Optional. With an e-mail the result is saved and the reply carries a personal report link.

governance.description: Who owns the AI topic? none = Nobody yet; discussed = It is discussed, nobody owns it; policy = There are rules, but no owner; owner = One person or team with a mandate

headcount.description: How many people work in that block? lt5 = Under 5; h5_20 = 5 to 20; h20_100 = 20 to 100; gt100 = More than 100

industry.description: Which industry are you in? automotive = Automotive; industrial = Industrial manufacturing; energy = Energy; hightech = Electronics and high-tech; appliances = Consumer appliances; other = Another industry

priority.description: Is there a mandate or budget for it? none = Not yet; listed = It is on the list; this_year = Planned for this year; budget = Budget is approved

repetitive_share.description: How much of the work in that block is repetitive? lt10 = Under 10 percent; s10_30 = 10 to 30 percent; s30_50 = 30 to 50 percent; gt50 = More than half

revenue.description: Roughly, what is your annual revenue? r5 = Under 5 million; r25 = 5 to 25 million; r100 = 25 to 100 million; r500 = 100 to 500 million; r500plus = More than 500 million; none = Rather not say

role.description: What is your role? founder_ceo = Founder or CEO; cxo = CxO or managing director; head = Head of a division or department; manager = Team lead or project lead; other = Something else

size.description: How many people work in your company? s50 = Under 50; s250 = 50 to 250; s1000 = 250 to 1,000; s1000plus = More than 1,000

skills.description: How much AI know-how is in the team? none = Hardly any; enthusiasts = A few enthusiasts; trained = Trained users; experts = People who build with it

standardisation.description: How standardised is the work there? adhoc = Everyone does it their own way; partly = Partly, with templates; documented = Documented processes; measured = Documented and measured

time_sink.description: Where does most of the time go in that block? documentation = Writing documents and reports; reporting = Collecting figures and reporting; search = Searching for information; customer_comms = Answering customers and partners; data_entry = Moving data between systems; coordination = Meetings and coordination

timeline.description: When do you want to start? none = Just exploring; m12 = Within twelve months; m6 = Within six months; now = Now

tools.description: How is AI used in your company today? none = Not at all; individuals = A few people use ChatGPT and the like; pilots = First pilot projects; rollout = Live in one area; embedded = Part of several processes

name: ai_impact_analysis
title: AI Impact Analysis
